eyebrow: The part we'd want to know about
headline: It doesn't last forever.
body1: The host picks how long the album stays open: 3, 7, 14 or 30 days. Then it closes and the photos are removed.
body2: So save the ones you want before then. We'd rather say it now than have you find out later.
note: Pick up by 17 Nov, then it's gone.

is.label: What it is
is.body: One album per event, for the people who were there. Join with a link or QR.

isnt.label: What it isn't
isnt.body: There's nothing to scroll and nobody to perform for. It's an album.
